privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro1: Clipio ("we", "us", or "our") is a browser extension available for Chrome and Firefox (the "Extension"). This Privacy Policy explains how we handle your information when you use Clipio.
privacy.intro2: By installing or using the Extension, you agree to this Privacy Policy.
privacy.section1aTitle: a. Snippet Data (stored locally on your device)
privacy.section1aBodyBefore: All snippets you create — including their shortcut, label, content, and tags — are stored exclusively on your device using the browser's built-in
privacy.section1aBodyAfter: APIs. Snippet data may be synced across your own devices by the browser's native sync infrastructure (e.g., Chrome Sync or Firefox Sync) if you are signed in to your browser; this sync is performed directly by the browser and is outside Clipio's control.
privacy.section1aEmphasis: We never transmit your snippet content to our servers.
privacy.section1bBody: To detect and fix bugs we collect anonymized error reports through Sentry (see Section 4). Error reports may include:
section1bItems: Stack trace (file and line number references within the extension's own code)
The extension context where the error occurred (background, popup, options, or content script)
The operation that triggered the error (e.g., loadSnippets)
Snippet shortcut text and snippet label (e.g., ;gr or "Greeting template")
privacy.section1bNeverTitle: The following data is never included in error reports:
section1bNeverItems: The URLs of pages you visit in your browser
privacy.section1cTitle: c. Image Data (stored locally on your device)
privacy.section1cBody: Images you upload or save through the Extension are stored exclusively on your device in IndexedDB. Images are never transmitted to our servers. They remain under your control and can be deleted at any time from the Extension's settings.
privacy.section2Intro: We use diagnostic data solely to:
section2Items: Detect and fix bugs and technical errors in the Extension
Detect technical issues that could affect users
privacy.section2Note: We do not use your data for advertising, profiling, or any purpose other than maintaining a functional, reliable extension.
privacy.section3Body: All snippet data is stored locally on your device. Clipio does not operate a backend server that receives or stores your snippets. The Extension maintains a local IndexedDB store for snippets (as a backup/recovery mechanism) and for images you save. None of this data is ever sent to any server.
privacy.section4Body: We use the following third-party services in connection with Clipio:
privacy.giphyPurpose: GIF search within the Extension editor
privacy.giphyNote: When you search for GIFs, only your search query is sent to Giphy's API directly from your browser. Clipio does not transmit any personal data, identifiers, or browsing history to Giphy. A Giphy API key bundled in the Extension is included in API requests for authentication purposes; it identifies the application, not the user.
privacy.vercelPurpose: Anonymous website page-view metrics (website only, not the Extension)
privacy.vercelNote: The Clipio website (clipio.xyz) uses Vercel Analytics to collect anonymous, aggregated page-view data. No personal information, cookies, or user identifiers are collected. Vercel Analytics does not track users across sites.
privacy.section4Note: Sentry is a U.S.-based company that complies with GDPR through Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs). Error reports are retained for 90 days and then automatically deleted.
privacy.section5Body: If you are in the European Economic Area (EEA), our legal basis for processing diagnostic error data is legitimate interest — detecting and fixing software defects to maintain a reliable and secure extension.
privacy.euBody: Access, correct, delete, restrict, or port your data, and withdraw consent.
privacy.usBody: Request info on collection, deletion of data, and confirm data is not sold.
privacy.coBody: Know, update, and correct data. Request proof of authorization or deletion via SIC.
privacy.section7Body: All snippet and image data remains on your device. We automatically strip all snippet body content, clipboard data, and image data before transmission of error reports.
privacy.section8Body: The Extension is not intended for users under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children.
privacy.section9Body: We may update this Privacy Policy occasionally. Continued use constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
privacy.section10Body: For any questions or requests regarding privacy:

steps.title: Welcome to Clipio
steps.description: Your browser extension for instant text expansion. Save your most-used texts as snippets and insert them anywhere on the web — with a single shortcut. Stop retyping the same emails, greetings, code blocks, or support replies.
bullets: Works in Gmail, Notion, Slack, GitHub, and everywhere else
Your snippets stay private — stored only in your browser

steps.title: Create your first snippet
steps.description: A snippet has three fields: a label (just for you), a shortcut, and the content that gets inserted. The rich text editor supports bold, lists, links, images, and GIFs.
bullets: Label: a friendly name only you see, e.g. "Support closing"
Shortcut: what you type to trigger it, e.g. /closing
Content: supports rich text — bold, lists, code blocks, and more

steps.title: Type once, expand anywhere
steps.description: Type your shortcut in any text field on any website. Clipio instantly replaces it with your full content — no copy-paste, no windows to switch.
bullets: Triggers on Space or Tab after the shortcut
Or just pause — Clipio auto-expands after a configurable timeout (default 300 ms)

steps.title: Make snippets dynamic
steps.description: Go beyond static text with smart placeholders that resolve at expansion time. The editor shows them as interactive chips you can click to configure.
bullets: {{clipboard}} — inserts whatever is currently in your clipboard
{{date:long}} — inserts today's full date, e.g. March 14, 2026
{{cursor}} — places your cursor exactly where you want after expansion

steps.title: Images, GIFs & slash commands
steps.description: Type / in the editor to open the command menu. Insert images stored locally in your browser, or animated GIFs from Giphy — all without leaving the keyboard.
bullets: /image opens the Image Picker — select a stored image or upload a new one
/gif opens the GIF Picker — search Giphy's library and insert animated GIFs
Manage your image library from Settings → Images; more commands may be added over time

steps.title: Always in sync
steps.description: Clipio syncs your library across all your browsers automatically. Install on your work machine and personal laptop — your snippets appear on both within seconds.
bullets: Automatic fallback to local storage if your library grows beyond the sync quota
Assign tags to keep your library organized as it grows
Export any time as JSON for backup or sharing with your team

It was missing features I needed
It caused browser issues or slowed things down
I just don't need it anymore
I was only testing it out
